name: George Montagu
bio: A rich school friend of Lord Alfred Douglas, described by McDermott as heir to an earldom; Olive Custance's official fiancé at the time of her elopement with Douglas in March 1902.
bio_sources: McDermott, 'Poison pen of a Fairy Prince' (2020)
bio_note: The engagement from Douglas's Autobiography (1929), p. 197, where the King's letter congratulates Mrs Custance on 'her daughter's engagement to George'; the school friendship and heirship from McDermott. Neither passage has been read on the page (see READING_LOG).
